title: 497. Serialize and Deserialize N-ary Tree

examples.explanation: Parsing and re-serializing preserves the grouping.
The empty tree round-trips to itself.
A deeper tree survives the double round-trip unchanged.

hints: Parse the bracket string by splitting on commas and treating null as a group boundary.
Rebuild with a queue: each group after a null belongs to the next queued node.
Serializing is the mirror: emit root, then each node's children group separated by null.
